variants.headline: A rival's culture becomes influential over us
body: The cultural influence a rival civilization holds over our nation has reached the Influential level. The measure stands at {{percentage}} percent.

variants.headline: In this year the voice of {{rival}} grew strong
body: It is recorded that in this year the influence of {{rival}} over our people attained the Influential level, the measure standing at {{percentage}} percent. The scribes set down the figure and offered no judgment upon it.

variants.headline: Their songs are in our houses
body: The influence of {{rival}} over our nation now stands at the Influential level. Somebody was meant to keep our songs, our stages and our schools alive, and the count of foreign influence says how that work went. This paper wants the failure named in council, and the funds for our own work found before the next count.

variants.headline: What the Influential mark measures
body: The Influential mark is a measurement, not a mood: it records that a rival's ideas now spread among us faster than our own can answer. The count over our nation stands at {{percentage}} percent. What the figure cannot say is whether the rise has finished, and the next count should be watched for the answer.

variants.headline: Our culture becomes influential over a rival
body: Our cultural influence over a rival civilization has reached the Influential level. The measure stands at {{percentage}} percent, and our works now shape the tastes of another nation.

variants.headline: Hear it! Our culture wins {{rival}}
body: Hear it, people! Our influence over {{rival}} has reached the Influential level, {{percentage}} percent on the count! Our plays fill their theaters and our songs their streets! Influential! Let every hearth know it.

variants.headline: Influential over {{rival}}: a standing no treaty gives
body: The public of {{rival}} now takes its cues from our artists and our thinkers, and the count stands at {{percentage}} percent. No treaty confers a standing like this. Only the work does, and the work should not stop here.

variants.headline: Our plays pack a rival capital
body: Letters from a rival capital relate that our plays now play to full houses there, night after night. By the official count, our cultural influence over that nation has reached the Influential level. The applause, our correspondent writes, is sincere.

variants.headline: Foreign influence over us slips to {{level}}
body: The cultural influence a rival civilization holds over our nation has fallen from {{previousLevel}} to {{level}}. The measure stands at {{percentage}} percent.

variants.headline: The hold of {{rival}} on our tastes loosens
body: Influence is won slowly and surrendered slowly. The hold of {{rival}} on our tastes has slipped from {{previousLevel}} to {{level}}. A nation that hears its own songs again stands a little more on its own ground.

variants.headline: Give us back our songs
body: The influence of {{rival}} over us has fallen to {{level}}, and the foreign fashion that filled our markets and stages is losing its hold. The chance now belongs to our own singers, our own weavers, our own cooks. This paper's word: spend your coin on your own street while the chance is ours.

variants.headline: In this year the foreign fashion faded
body: It is recorded that the influence of a foreign people over our nation fell in this year from {{previousLevel}} to {{level}}. What was borrowed is slowly being returned.

variants.headline: Our influence abroad slips to {{level}}
body: Our cultural influence over a rival civilization has fallen from {{previousLevel}} to {{level}}. The measure stands at {{percentage}} percent.

variants.headline: Somebody let our hold on {{rival}} slip
body: Our influence over {{rival}} has slipped from {{previousLevel}} to {{level}}. A standing abroad is not kept by luck; it is kept by steady work, and ours has gone untended. The offices charged with that work should account for the lapse, and in public.

variants.headline: Our fashions carry less weight in {{rival}}
body: Letters from {{rival}} relate that our styles no longer set theirs as they did. By the recorded count, our influence in that nation has fallen from {{previousLevel}} to {{level}}.

variants.headline: They've stopped singing our songs
body: A trader back from the foreign port shrugged when we asked about our songs. "They know the words," he said. "They've stopped singing them." Our influence abroad has fallen to {{level}}.

variants.headline: Foreign influence over us turns {{trend}}
body: The cultural influence a rival civilization holds over our nation has turned {{trend}}, after {{previousTrend}}. The measure stands at {{percentage}} percent, at the {{level}} level.

variants.headline: Influential in {{turnsToInfluential}} turns, on this course
body: The foreign influence held over our nation has turned {{trend}}, and on the current course the projection gives {{turnsToInfluential}} turns until it reaches the Influential level. A projection holds only while the course does. The next count will show whether the pace is keeping.

variants.headline: Foreign cloth all over the market again
body: You see it at the cloth stalls first. The foreign bolt is everywhere this season, and the counters agree with the stalls: the influence of {{rival}} over us has turned {{trend}}.

variants.headline: The influence ledger
body: Level held over our nation: {{level}}
Reading: {{percentage}} percent
Trend: {{trend}}, after {{previousTrend}}

variants.headline: Our influence abroad turns {{trend}}
body: Our cultural influence over a rival civilization has turned {{trend}}, after {{previousTrend}}. The measure stands at {{percentage}} percent, at the {{level}} level.

variants.headline: Influence rising: influential in {{turnsToInfluential}} turns
body: Our influence over a rival power is {{trend}}. The projection puts the Influential level {{turnsToInfluential}} turns away. The figures are firm.

variants.headline: Our fashions rise again in {{rival}}
body: Letters from {{rival}} relate that our styles are once more in the ascendant there, and the recorded count agrees: the trend in our influence has turned Rising, at the {{level}} level.

variants.headline: In this year our word carried less weight
body: It is recorded that our influence over {{rival}} turned from Rising to Falling in this year, and rests at the {{level}} level. The scribes set the change down as it was measured.

variants.headline: Culture is a front line too
body: The trend in our influence over a rival has turned {{trend}}, at the {{level}} level. Strength is counted in soldiers and coin, and also in whose stories the other side tells itself. A falling count is ground lost without a battle; a rising one is ground taken.

variants.headline: {{city}} completes the {{wonder}} under an enemy flag
body: The enemy city of {{city}} has finished the {{wonder}} within sight of our borders. The work is done, and it did not wait for the war to end.

variants.headline: An enemy wonder rises near our borders
body: An enemy city close to our own has completed the {{wonder}}. The work stands finished inside a nation we are at war with, and near enough to matter.

variants.headline: The {{wonder}} is more than a monument
body: A wonder draws travelers, travelers draw coin, and coin keeps armies in the field. The enemy's new {{wonder}} at {{city}} will do all three for a nation we are at war with. The commanders should weigh it accordingly.

variants.headline: A fine hall under a hostile flag
body: Advice reaches this office that the {{wonder}} now stands finished in enemy {{city}}. Whatever banner hangs above it, the workmanship is said to be very fine. It is a melancholy thing that so fine a hall should rise under a hostile sky.

variants.headline: The boys came back talking of towers
body: The herd boys came down at dusk talking of towers across the line, taller than anything on our side. The enemy city of {{city}} has raised the {{wonder}}. The capital can call the war its own affair. When you can see the enemy's towers from the pasture, the war is yours too.

variants.headline: {{cityName}} completes the {{wonder}}
body: The {{wonder}} stands finished in {{cityName}}, a city of {{civilization}}. Word of the work arrived with the last stones set.

variants.headline: A wonder completed abroad
body: The {{wonder}} now stands complete in a foreign city. Word of the work reached us after the scaffolds came down.

variants.headline: Why the {{wonder}} matters to {{civilization}}
body: A wonder is a nation's claim to be remembered. With the {{wonder}}, {{civilization}} has made that claim and set the mark for every rival. The right answer is not envy. It is a finer work of our own, and the plans should already be drawn.

variants.headline: They speak of the new hall at {{cityName}}
body: They say the scaffolds came down at {{cityName}} this season, and the {{wonder}} stood in the open air for the first time. The travelers who came home talk of little else, and they will walk you through every stone if you let them.

variants.headline: The {{wonder}} at {{cityName}} is complete
body: Letters from {{cityName}} relate that the {{wonder}} now stands finished there, and that visitors of every nation are already on the road to see it. Whatever divides the courts, a work like this is a pleasure shared. May it long draw a crowd.

variants.headline: A great person is born in {{civilization}}
body: The great person {{person}} has been born to {{civilization}}. Births of this order are rare, and word of this one has already crossed the borders on its own.

variants.headline: A great person is born
body: A great person, {{person}}, has come into the world. Which court will count them among its own remains to be seen, and more than one court is asking.

variants.headline: In this year a {{unit}} came to {{civilization}}
body: It is recorded for this year that {{civilization}} received the {{unit}} {{person}}, newly born. The scribes have set the name down in full, as is owed to a name of that order.

variants.headline: A great person of our own
body: {{person}} is ours. A great person is a nation's rarest instrument, and the question before the court is where to point it: a work of art, a work of state, or a work of war. Whichever it chooses, the nation will be known by the choosing.

variants.headline: Citizens! A rival has a new great person
body: Citizens, mark it: {{civilization}} counts the great person {{person}} among its own, and we do not. A rival's genius is a rival's strength, and the tally of power has moved in their favor. Pretending otherwise will not move it back.

variants.headline: The death of {{person}}
body: The great person {{person}} of {{civilization}} has died. The name was known well beyond that nation's borders, and the news of its passing is traveling just as far.

variants.headline: The world is one name poorer
body: {{person}} of {{civilization}} is dead. The name was spoken in many lands in its lifetime, and the work it leaves behind is written in ledgers no fire will reach. What remains is memory, and memory is a trust. May the nation that held them keep it well.

variants.headline: {{killer}} kills {{person}}
body: The great person {{person}} of {{civilization}} has died at the hands of {{killer}}. A killing of this kind settles nothing. It is a blow struck in a contest of strength, and such blows are rarely the last of the exchange.

variants.headline: Our own {{person}} is gone
body: They sat late at the fires tonight. {{person}}, one of our own, is gone. The stories started before the fire burned low, and by tomorrow every hearth will have its favorite.

variants.headline: Somebody sent {{person}} to their death
body: {{person}} is dead at the hands of {{killer}}. Somebody gave the orders that put one of our greatest within an enemy's reach, and that somebody has a name and a desk. This paper wants the name, and it wants the orders read aloud in council.

variants.headline: A great person spent: {{person}}
body: {{civilization}} has expended the great person {{person}}, turning a whole lifetime's gift into a single great act. The act is done and cannot be taken back. What it bought will show itself in the seasons ahead.

variants.headline: Notice: {{person}} spent in the nation's service
body: Notice is given that the great person {{person}} has been expended in the nation's service. The council turned the gift to a purpose of state with its usual foresight, and the public's thanks are owed.

variants.headline: A talent spent is a bet on the present
body: Expenditure converts a person's whole future into one immediate act, and {{civilization}} has made that trade with {{person}}. The sums will show in time whether the trade was wise. The person was not consulted.

variants.headline: Nobody came out of the palace
body: In {{civilization}} they say {{person}} walked into the palace one last time. The doors opened once, then closed, and the gift was spent inside. Nobody came out.

variants.headline: Great works come to {{city}}
body: The galleries of {{city}} have gained {{added}} great works, lifting the city's collection to {{total}}.

variants.headline: Notice to lovers of the arts
body: {{city}} is richer by {{added}} great works, making {{total}} in all. The galleries keep their usual hours, and the walls, as ever, do the talking.

variants.headline: What {{total}} great works mean for {{city}}
body: A collection is a city's hold on the attention of the world. With {{added}} new works, {{city}} now holds {{total}}, and each one is a reason for a traveler to stop and an answer to a rival's galleries.

variants.headline: The crates came up from the docks
body: The crates came up from the docks before dawn, and by evening {{added}} new works hung in the galleries of {{city}}. The guards were already shooing off the first admirers, who had waited at the door since noon.

variants.headline: Great works lost from {{city}}
body: The galleries of {{city}} are {{lost}} great works lighter than at the last count. {{total}} works remain on the walls.

variants.headline: The walls of {{city}} are barer
body: The galleries of {{city}} held more at their height. {{lost}} great works are gone from the walls, and {{total}} remain. What is left inherits the rooms, and the duty of keeping them.

variants.headline: Our art walked out of {{city}}
body: The galleries of {{city}} are {{lost}} great works lighter, and no one in office has said how. Works do not walk off walls on their own. This paper wants a cause, a name, and a promise it can check.

variants.headline: The nail is still in the wall
body: The old keeper says the nail is still in the wall, right where the painting hung. {{lost}} great works are gone from {{city}}. The capital will hardly notice. The city notices every empty frame.

variants.headline: Our wonder stands: the {{wonder}} at {{city}}
body: Work in {{city}} is finished. The {{wonder}} stands under our flag, the newest of the works the whole world knows by name.

variants.headline: A wonder of our own is finished
body: The {{wonder}} is complete. Of all the works a nation raises, a wonder is the one the whole world agrees to call by name.

variants.headline: Hear it, people of {{city}}! The {{wonder}} is done
body: The scaffolds are down! The {{wonder}} stands, finished and ours! Let the neighbors come and see what we build. Let them carry the sight home with them!

variants.headline: What the {{wonder}} gives {{city}}
body: A wonder is more than a landmark. For {{city}} it means travelers on the road and the nation's name spoken in rooms we have never entered. A wonder is also a dare: the next one should already be on the drawing board.

variants.headline: The children are playing under it already
body: The last scaffold plank came down at noon, and by evening the children of {{city}} were playing beneath the {{wonder}}, every one of them promising to build a bigger one.

variants.headline: A new leader in tourism: {{civilization}}
body: {{civilization}} now stands first in the world in tourism, at {{tourism}} a turn. The lead belonged to another power at the last count.

variants.headline: A new leader in tourism
body: The world has a new leader in tourism, at {{tourism}} a turn. The name behind the numbers has not yet reached this desk.

variants.headline: {{civilization}} now leads the world in tourism
body: Figures now place {{civilization}} first among the nations in tourism, at {{tourism}} a turn and clear of the field. Where the traveler's coin goes, influence follows, and both are now headed the same way.

variants.headline: {{civilization}} shares the tourism lead
body: {{civilization}} stands level with another great power at {{tourism}} tourism a turn. First place is real. The sole holding of it is not.

variants.headline: New No. 1 in tourism: {{civilization}}
body: {{civilization}}, at {{tourism}} a turn. The previous leader has a number to chase now.
